title: Coaching Management System
shortDescription: Basic frontend and CRUD API with JWT authentication. React frontend, Node.js/Express backend, Supabase database.
fullDescription: A full-featured coaching institute management web application created to streamline student enrollments, batch scheduling, tuition fee tracking, teacher assignments, and course administration. Built with React for an intuitive frontend and Node.js/Express with Supabase for secure REST API endpoints.
challenges: Structuring clean relational database schemas in Supabase for multi-entity relationships across students, courses, and payments.
Designing robust JWT authentication middleware with auto-refresh logic to safeguard admin routes.
Building dynamic, high-performance data tables with client-side searching and sorting.
futurePlans: Incorporate an online exam and automated grading system for batch assessments.
Implement student attendance tracking with mobile QR code scanning.
Add parent-teacher portal with push notifications for exam results and fee reminders.
